title: OMR Lab run document
description: Normalized record of one OMR pipeline run (the run envelope). Records only facts supported by the pipeline and engine output; see docs/json-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Changes to the contract require a new schema file and version.

status.description: Outcome of the run. 'succeeded' means the pipeline completed; it is not a claim that the music was recognized correctly.

input.description: The source document given to the pipeline.

filename.description: Base name of the input file (no directory components).

media_type.description: IANA media type of the input, or null when it was not determined.

sha256.description: Optional lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the input bytes, or null when not computed.

engine.description: Provenance of the OMR engine that was selected for the run.

version.description: Engine version as reported by the engine, or null when unknown. Never guessed.

options.$comment: Placeholder for engine options (issue #21). Keys are option names; values are the effective JSON values. Empty when no options were given.
options.description: Effective run/engine options recorded for provenance.

artifacts.description: Raw engine and pipeline artifacts, keyed by artifact kind (e.g. 'musicxml'). Values are POSIX-style paths relative to the run output directory (no absolute paths, backslashes, control characters such as newlines, or '..' segments). Kept separate from normalized content.

duration_seconds.description: Total elapsed time of the run in seconds.

started_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp at which the run started, or null.

score.$comment: Placeholder: the normalized score content model is defined by issue #19 and will be introduced in a later schema version. In 0.1.0 score is always null.
score.description: Normalized musical content. null means no normalized musical content is available; it is not an empty or recognized score.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems observed during the run, in order of occurrence.

error.description: Failure details. Required to be an object when status is 'failed' and null when status is 'succeeded'.

code.description: Stable snake_case error identifier (see docs/json-schema.md for known codes).

returncode.description: Engine process return code when the failure came from an external process, otherwise null.
